title: Are Tankers Going The Distance
summary:
What is happening to the average voyage length of crude
oil tankers? Tanker market pundits are continuously discussing the reasons for the strength of the market, especially since the world is experiencing only modest demand growth. What are the key drivers for the significant increases in rates?
